pipeline.purpose: Collect files, APIs, databases, sensors, and governed event data.
Clean duplicates, missing values, schemas, features, and embeddings.
Prepare structured features, vector indexes, retrieval stores, or context bundles.
Govern training, fine tuning, prompting, or adaptation plans when authorized.
Evaluate accuracy, safety, regression, overfitting, bias, and contract compliance.
Deploy as governed API, batch job, agent tool, or runtime service.
Monitor model drift, data drift, latency, cost, incidents, and quality.
